title: The photo from the coast
brief: You're Tomás. Don Hernando comes into the café proud of a photo his son has sent from the Caribbean coast. Ask about it, tell him what you have and haven't done, and help him with a small mix-up. He's older than you, so use usted with him; he uses tú with you.

turns.npc: Tomás, una foto de mi hijo. Está visitando la costa.
turns.npcEn: Tomás, a photo of my son. He's visiting the coast.
turns.intent: Ask him what his son is doing in the photo.

require.label: what he's doing right now: está haciendo

turns.npc: Está nadando en el mar, en una isla cerca de Cartagena. ¿Tú has estado en Cartagena?
turns.npcEn: He's swimming in the sea, on an island near Cartagena. Have you been to Cartagena?
turns.intent: Say not yet, and ask whether he has been there.
accept: Todavía no. ¿Usted ha estado en Cartagena?
No, todavía no. ¿Y usted ha estado allí?

require.label: ask with usted: ¿ha estado?, not ¿has estado?

turns.npc: Muchas veces. Fui con mi esposa hace cuarenta años. ¿Y sabes bucear?
turns.npcEn: Lots of times. I went with my wife forty years ago. And do you know how to dive?
turns.intent: Say you don't know how to dive, but you can swim.
accept: No, no sé bucear, pero sé nadar.
Sé nadar, pero no sé bucear.
No sé bucear. Pero sé nadar.

require.label: don't know how to dive: no sé bucear
know how to swim: sé nadar

turns.npc: Yo tampoco. ¿Y dónde está mi foto? ¿La tienes tú?
turns.npcEn: Me neither. And where's my photo? Have you got it?
turns.intent: Say yes, you've got it, it's right here.
accept: Sí, aquí está. La tengo yo.

turns.npc: Gracias, mijo. El domingo mi hijo viene a Bogotá. Y quiere conocer al canadiense.
turns.npcEn: Thanks, son. On Sunday my son is coming to Bogotá. And he wants to meet the Canadian.
turns.intent: Say of course, you want to meet his son too.
accept: Claro, yo también quiero conocer a su hijo.
Claro, quiero conocer a su hijo.
¡Claro! Yo también quiero conocer a su hijo.

require.label: meet a person for the first time: conocer

turns.npc: Y tú, ¿cuándo vas a la costa? Mijo, vale la pena ir.
turns.npcEn: And you, when are you going to the coast? Son, it's worth going.
turns.intent: Say no idea, but you want to go.
